scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.notes: AI powerhouse outcome: Search/YouTube monetization improves, Cloud exceeds 20%+ growth with ~30% margins, and optionality (Waymo/Other Bets) contributes meaningfully.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.notes: Steady compounder: Search/YouTube remain dominant, Cloud grows mid-teens then slows, Other Bets roughly breakeven, EPS compounds ~10% with strong buybacks.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.notes: Moat pressure and stagnation: AI agents erode search, YouTube growth stalls, Cloud slows to high-single digits with margin pressure, and regulation adds cost.

evidence_for: Google Cloud operating margins expanding consistently above 10%.
Custom TPU v5p/v6 Trillium infrastructure delivering cost leadership vs merchant GPU clouds.
Gemini integration across Google Workspace and Android providing broad consumer/enterprise distribution.
evidence_against: DOJ antitrust search remedies create uncertainty around default distribution agreements.
AI search answers increase inference compute cost relative to traditional ad clicks.
Rising datacenter depreciation schedule putting pressure on near-term gross margins.
open_questions: Will Search ad query volume and monetisation hold steady as AI Overviews scale?
Can GCP capture incremental enterprise generative AI workloads relative to Azure?

predictions.claim: Google Cloud reports annual operating margin > 12% in FY2025/2026
predictions.notes: Tests structural profitability and scale leverage of GCP and TPU fleet.

predictions.claim: Google Search & Other revenue growth remains positive YoY throughout 2026
predictions.notes: Validates resilience of core search moat against standalone AI agents.

decision_journal.situation: Alphabet trading at ~24x forward P/E, reasonable valuation relative to hyperscaler peer group with high net cash.
alternatives_rejected: Increase allocation to max 25% (rejected: antitrust regulatory overhang warrants keeping dry powder).
Trim on DOJ headlines (rejected: underlying free cash flow generation and TPU advantage are durable).
